stability_evidence.required_fix: Keep Hakim in a user-visible foreground continuity service and retain the idempotent 60s schedule heartbeat; no root, verifier bypass, or protection disabling.

continuity.decision: 20055 remains the last fully field-verified baseline. 20058 is the currently installed D1 identity; its exact APK preserved data and passed three cold starts with no new SQLite leak or ANR, but TECNO/Transsion TranHiber still proxies/cancels Job 771208 after backgrounding. Candidate 20059 keeps the 20058 DB and idempotent scheduler fixes and adds a lightweight user-visible foreground continuity service that performs no WebView or new network work and requires no new permission.

rules: Newer direct read-only evidence from the real phone supersedes older checkpoints; the current direct baseline is 20055/D1.
Any in-place update for the current phone must be signed exactly by certificate_sha256 (D1).
F4 is historical and must not be used to overwrite the current D1 installation.
The known 4C companion signer must never be accepted for ps.hakim.stable.
Do not uninstall the current app or clear its data as part of routine updating.
Do not require or encourage Android unknown-source installation permission as a standing capability.
Do not store private signing material or pairing secrets in this public repository.
Maintain exactly one user-facing Hakim Android app: ps.hakim.stable.
Build or CI success alone does not establish physical-phone field qualification.
current_candidate_version is not field-qualified until the exact delivered signed artifact is verified on the real phone.
If a future phone read contradicts this baseline, fail closed and update the baseline only from the newer direct evidence.
Direct package/version/APK/signer evidence establishes field identity only; runtime stability remains a separate gate and is not inherited.
A field version may be current by identity while failing stability; identity evidence must never be promoted to runtime acceptance.
Background jobs must not hold JobScheduler on optional network telemetry; nonessential health transmission must be asynchronous and coalesced.
A candidate with no ANR may still fail acceptance if a periodic job remains active materially longer than its bounded local work requires.
A periodic watchdog must have a hard JobScheduler deadline; optional diagnosis, health, or self-check work must continue asynchronously and must not keep the job active past that deadline.
A periodic watchdog must not reschedule its own JobInfo from work launched by that same watchdog; schedule maintenance is suppressed inside the watchdog execution path.
Professional UI must not add Android permissions, exported activities, or runtime dependencies without a separately qualified need.
Professional releases must inherit the 20055 watchdog hard deadline and self-reschedule suppression and prove no regression on the real phone.
Recovery schedule() must be idempotent: if the same generation of Job 771208 already exists for the correct service, keep it unchanged; do not replace a pending or running JobInfo.
Quran SQLite access must reuse one process-lifetime application-scoped SQLiteOpenHelper; per-query helpers that rely on GC for close are forbidden.
Recovery scheduling must self-heal if OEM removes Job 771208 while the app process is alive, using only idempotent checks; self-healing must not replace a correct existing generation.
On TECNO/Transsion, field acceptance requires continuity to survive OEM job proxy/cancel behavior; JobScheduler presence alone is not a sufficient continuity primitive.
The foreground continuity service must be exported=false, START_STICKY, user-visible, and must not create WebView, new remote transport, root flow, or disable Android protections.
